A Clean Synthetic Firm Panel for FHK Examples

fhk_example.Rd

A synthetic, unbalanced firm panel covering 2010–2012. It contains stable industry codes, genuine endpoint entry and exit consistent with registry-style activity windows, raw employment weights, and two types of pre-computed shares.

Usage

fhk_example

Format

A data frame with 20 rows and 10 variables:

firm_id

Synthetic firm identifier.

year

Observation year.

industry

Stable two-sector industry classification.

productivity

Primary synthetic productivity measure.

productivity_alt

Alternative productivity measure.

employment

Raw size weight.

global_share

Employment share summing to one within year.

within_industry_share

Employment share summing to one within industry-year.

first_active_year

Registry-style first activity year.

last_active_year

Registry-style last activity year.

Source

Generated by data-raw/generate_example_data.R.

Examples

data(fhk_example)
head(fhk_example)
#>   firm_id year      industry productivity productivity_alt employment
#> 1       A 2010 Manufacturing          3.2             3.23        100
#> 2       B 2010 Manufacturing          2.8             2.78         80
#> 3       C 2010 Manufacturing          3.6             3.61         60
#> 4       D 2010      Services          2.5             2.53        120
#> 5       E 2010      Services          2.2             2.18         70
#> 6       F 2010      Services          2.9             2.91         50
